name: mongoose-claude-harness
description: Mongoose controller with a Claude worker, ChatGPT or Claude coordinator, and Claude Opus specialist.

scripts.test:browser: node -e "process.env.HARNESS_BROWSER_TESTS='1'; require('child_process').execSync('npx vitest run test/browser', {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env})"
